name: dpmode-same
summary: DisplayPort Mode: selecting the mode that is already set does nothing (stock: re-applies it with a 650 ms hot-plug pulse, which blanks every monitor behind a dock, and leaves the input disabled); a real change is applied and the input enabled again (stock left it disabled when the DSC setting did not change, e.g. "1.4 without DSC" <-> 1.2)
status: hardware-tested 2026-10-08: same mode -> nothing; 1.4 -> 1.4 without DSC -> 1.2 -> 1.4 with the PC at 4K 60 Hz: picture after every change (at 4K 144 Hz, 1.2 has no picture: the mode does not fit HBR2 without DSC)
